messages:
Morgan: Quick proposal -- a compact remediation ops flow to reduce postmortem drift. Sketch below. Open to tweaks.

Alex: Nice. Love the lean approach. Can we automate owner reminders and a single canonical link (GH issue or Notion) from day 0? :+1:

Priya: Agreed. Also want tags for recurring problem types (kv-cache, routing-fallback, auth-throttle, network-e2e). makes trend analysis easier later.

Chris: Minimal template I used in the spike: 
```
- owner: @alex
- due: 2026-04-12
- summary: batch-size increase caused M60 OOMs during peak traffic
- mitigation: rollback to batch=32 on canary, monitor cpu/mem
- rollout: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (manual checks at each step)
- metrics-to-watch: oom_count, p95_latency, batch_retry_rate
- recurrence-tags: kv-cache,memory-pressure
- status: open / in-progress / blocked / done
```

Sam: Two lightweight rules to add: (1) owner must be assigned before postmortem is marked closed; (2) owners get automated reminders at 3d/7d/14d/30d, and if unresponsive >72h escalate to oncall lead.

Taylor: IC rotation thought: 2-week primary IC, 1-week secondary shadow. Handoff checklist should include "open actions with owners+due dates" and an "active mitigations" section.

Morgan: Proposed follow-up cadence: owner check-ins at 3d/7d/14d/30d. After 30d, anything still open moves to the recurring-remediations board for prioritization. oncall-bot will post short updates in the incident thread.

oncall-bot: Command examples: 
`/remediate create --owner @alex --due 2026-04-12 --tags kv-cache,memory-pressure --notify 3d,7d,14d,30d`
`/remediate escalate --owner @alex --to @oncall-lead --after 72h`

Alex: Can we have the bot also create a GH issue for infra touching changes and link it back? saves duplication.

Priya: Yes. Also add an optional `recurrence-review` checkbox series (30/90/180 days) so we schedule longer-term reviews for systemic issues.

Chris: I'll prototype a script that turns the template into a GH issue and wires up the bot. 30-min spike scheduled tomorrow. I'll post the results here.

Sam: Process suggestion: "open-by-default, close-by-owner" meaning we keep incidents open until remediations are owned and scheduled. reduces silent drift.

Taylor: Also recommend a monthly "remediation triage" meeting to surface actions older than 90 days and surface pattern tags to leadership.

Morgan: Next steps: 
1) Chris: spike GH issue creation (tomorrow)
2) Alex: draft oncall-bot CLI and mapping to GH/Notion (this week)
3) Priya: propose taxonomy for recurrence-tags and one-pager guide
4) Taylor: update runbook with IC rotation + handoff template

Alex: Taking (2). PR with bot commands by Friday.

Priya: I'll draft taxonomy examples and share.

Chris: Spike booked, will share outputs here.

Sam: I'll run the first remediation triage next month.

Morgan: If no objections I'll update the runbook with the new mini-template and automation checklist. thanks all :tada:

Alex: :thumbsup:

Priya: LGTM

Chris: sounds good

oncall-bot: Reminder schedule saved: 3d,7d,14d,30d. GH issue creation enabled for infra-tagged remediations.
